title: Synthetic meal-logging evidence fixture — not runnable
hypothesis: This synthetic fixture exists only to validate protocol, consent, and safety gates.

intervention.summary: No food photography, nutrient target, or eating pattern is authorized.
steps: Do not collect a person's meal images or food notes with this fixture.
Complete privacy, eating-disorder, evidence, and clinical-legal review before any future proposal.

stop_conditions: The runtime must refuse to start this draft.

contraindications.label: Any real-person food tracking or eating-disorder context

safety.emergency_route: For an emergency, contact local emergency services; do not use this fixture.
